text:
sara_cs: heads-up: Brightleaf just emailed — they want to roll out LLM-powered document search + realtime meeting summaries to 3 new teams (Data Eng, Product Analytics, Customer Ops). renewal in ~8 weeks, could be a renewal + expansion play :eyes:

alex_m: nice. do we have usage numbers? is this new traffic or moving workloads over?

sara_cs: mix. product analytics will start nightly embed jobs (large batches), Data Eng wants low-latency QA assistant for internal tools (realtime). estimate: initial embed run ~1.2M docs -> ~2.5M embedding vectors, then ~10k reqs/day for retrieval + 150 rps for assistant during business hours. rough numbers from customer PO.

jamie_se: tagging for SE preflight — those embed volumes will need either dedicated capacity or batching/QPS sweep. @ops_bot can you check current Brightleaf committed tiers and burst available?

ops_bot: Brightleaf account summary:
• Plan: Standard Hosted (monthly)
• Committed units: 0 dedicated GPUs
• Recent 7d peak tokens: 1.1M/day
• Available burst policy: subject to capacity, no guaranteed SLA
(ask SE for Dedicated or reserve commit to secure throughput)

maria_onb: onboarding note — they finished core API integration last month, we did 1 workshop. They asked for an "enablement playbook" for embedding lifecycle + retriever tuning. I'll draft and run workshop w/ product analytics.

alex_m: sales angle — renewal + expansion likely if we offer predictable pricing for embed batch and a short Pilot Dedicated pool. I'll propose a 6mo reserved pool with canary routing.

jamie_se: technical action items:
1) validate nightly embed pipeline to avoid thundering herd (recommend chunking + parallel workers)
2) propose quantization profile for embeddings (float16 -> storage and cost savings)
3) set up prefix/KV caching for assistant to keep latency <150ms p95
4) sizing doc for Dedicated 2 x A100 equiv for first 3 months

sara_cs: marketing/CS asks:
- schedule enablement workshop wk of 2755558000 (customer time)
- capture feedback during workshop about retriever relevance (we want baseline prompts + eval set)
- ping legal if they request SOC2 addendum for new teams

alex_m: i'll draft commercial proposal and tag @maria_onb for workshop dates. want to avoid them hitting soft limits and getting throttled — that's a churn risk.

maria_onb: i'll collect 3 example docs and probable query load from product analytics ahead of workshop. also will ask for current embeddings schema.

jamie_se: i'll open an internal playbook ticket with SE runbook + cost estimate. quick sketch:
```
- Expected traffic: 10k embedding req/day (batch), 150 rps assistant peak
- Suggested infra: Dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv) + autoscale to 3x for nightly batch window
- Caching: prefix caching for 70% repeated context
- Estimated tokens/day: 3M -> est $X (TBD)
```

ops_bot: Created ticket #CS-8931 for Brightleaf expansion preflight. SE assigned: jamie_se. Sales opp: 5% chance closed-won this week, 72% within 6 weeks (auto estimate).

sara_cs: close loop: @alex_m please share proposal by EOD Fri. @jamie_se please add any blocking tech assumptions to ticket. i'll set workshop invite once maria confirms sample data. thx :pray:

alex_m: on it. will sync with finance for a predictable commit number.

maria_onb: thanks team — will post sample data by Thu. any objections to including a short eval rubric for retrieval relevance?

jamie_se: no objections. add it to the playbook ticket. small client ask but high signal for longer-term retention.

sara_cs: agreed — this feels like a healthy expansion signal with some urgency. main risk is capacity surprise during embed job. let's keep cadence tight this week. :rocket:
